title: Senior Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Account Executive at Vanta, you will hunt and win new logos across North America's mid-market. You'll own your pipeline, run a full-cycle new business sales process, and help security, IT, and business leaders make trust a competitive advantage. You'll join our newly launched Mid Market team, selling a platform that gets broader and more technical with every product we launch.

Our Senior Account Executives are hunters. SDRs and inbound are valuable partners, but our best AEs open doors themselves and own the pipeline it takes to hit their number. They are also curious learners: they go deep on a complex product and domain, run sharper discovery because of it, and tie what Vanta does to real business outcomes.

If this sounds like you, and you're excited to join a growing sales team, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as a Senior Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Build and own your pipeline: research target accounts, form a point of view on why they should talk to Vanta now, and run multi-channel outbound to open new logos

  • Partner with SDRs and capitalize on inbound demand, while owning the qualified pipeline needed to hit your number

  • Run the full sales cycle for mid-market companies 51-1000 employees, from first meeting through negotiation and close

  • Lead deep discovery with technical and business buyers, including CISOs, Heads of Security and IT, Engineering leaders, and executives

  • Connect Vanta to business outcomes like faster sales cycles, reduced risk, and lower cost of compliance, and build business cases that help your champions secure budget

  • Learn Vanta's platform deeply and keep pace as we launch new products and expand into new frameworks and use cases

  • Co-sell with Solutions Engineers, Value Engineers, GRC specialists, Channel, Deal Desk, and Legal

  • Maintain a healthy, accurate pipeline and forecast reliably against monthly and quarterly targets

  • Share customer insights with our product team to help shape the roadmap, and hand off smoothly to Customer Success

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying closing experience, including 3+ years in B2B SaaS with a strong track record of exceeding quota in fast-paced, competitive environments

  • 3+ years acquiring new customers with 51-1000 employees.

  • Proven hunter: Consistently builds qualified pipeline and wins new customers through their own prospecting.

  • Technical aptitude and curiosity: Learns complex products, leads deep discovery, and connects capabilities to business outcomes.

  • Comfortable leading consultative sales with multiple stakeholders, particularly selling complex solutions

  • Resourceful, resilient, and demonstrate a bias for action. You take ownership, move with urgency, and follow through.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

title: Software Engineer, Integrations Platform, Vanta For Government (V4G)
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Software Engineers build and own high-value products for our customers and the infrastructure that lets our business scale.

Vanta's team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it's essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to scale with our business. As a Software Engineer, you'll build and own full-stack features and platform primitives across our stack, work closely with the teams and partners who depend on what you ship, and grow into broader technical ownership. Your work will directly accelerate Vanta's growth.

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

The Integrations Platform team within Vanta Government Cloud mission is to power the world's largest trust automation ecosystem, enabling any person or agent to build, connect, and automate trust seamlessly.

Federal compliance is going through its biggest shift in a decade and this team builds the integration platform underneath Vanta Government Cloud that turns federal frameworks into automated, continuously monitored product experiences. This is a builder role: you'll turn federal control requirements into the platform primitives and integrations that make continuous authorization real.

We own Vanta's integration ecosystem within the US Government Cloud, which currently includes a growing set of integrations across Cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity Providers, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS). In this role, you'll build, own, support, and scale Vanta's Government Cloud integration operations. You'll build upon and extend the Integrations Platform, which includes shared primitives for authentication, lifecycle, observability, and publishing so that all integrations are built on the same foundation. Our North Star is to eliminate the barrier to building integrations entirely, enabling anyone to create an integration in minutes using declarative, low-code, and no-code patterns, supercharged by AI agents.

What you’ll do as a Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Design, build, and own full-stack features and platform primitives that internal teams, partners, and customers build on.

  • Deploy, operate, support, and maintain integrations running in Vanta's Government Cloud, including monitoring, on-call / incident response, and change management within the GovCloud boundary.

  • Contribute to our authentication, data-ingestion, and schema-evolution services, keeping integrations with external systems secure and reliable.

  • Partner with federal subject-matter experts to implement and maintain continuous-monitoring detectors and automated tests, with versioned framework mappings.

  • Build secure, well-documented, scalable services and UI with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Improve performance, operational excellence, and SDLC practices within the team.

  • Use AI tools and workflows to accelerate development and operations.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 6+ years of full-stack development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.

  • Platform and API design: you've built APIs and reusable components others depend on, with a solid grounding in RESTful APIs, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys, JWT), and security best practices.

  • Data integrations: you've built data ingestion from external systems (Cloud Providers, HRIS, Identity Providers, Code Repositories) using best practices like rate limiting, retries and idempotency, and webhooks.

  • Systems thinking: you design for scale, reliability, and failure modes. You look around corners, address edge cases, and proactively identify and address risk.

  • Collaboration: you partner with internal teams, Federal agencies employees, vendors, and Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAOs) to achieve mutual success. You incorporate their feedback into your designs, and are on a clear trajectory to broader technical ownership.

  • Interest in security or compliance: you're motivated by building trustworthy systems in a regulated environment.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Requirements

  • Physical location: you must reside in, and perform all work exclusively from within, the United States, accessing systems only from U.S. locations.

  • Work Authorization Requirements: You must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, FISMA) and how they apply to cloud and integration environments.

  • Experience building or operating in a government or otherwise regulated cloud environment (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or GCP) — deep familiarity with one translates well to the others.

Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, and interest in security or compliance products

title: Senior Product Designer, Agent Experience
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Product Designer, Agent Experience at Vanta, you will define how AI agents help security and compliance teams accomplish meaningful work with greater clarity, control, and trust across Vanta and the surfaces where our customers already work.

The Agent Experience team builds agent-led experiences that help security and compliance teams achieve outcomes with less manual effort. The team owns the agent harness, including agents, skills, tools, and memory, as well as the patterns that help customers understand, guide, review, correct, and trust agent-generated work. Our goal is to make AI-powered workflows useful, transparent, and dependable in a product where clarity and correctness matter.

As a Senior Product Designer on this team, you will shape both the underlying agent experience and the customer-facing workflows built on top of it. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, AI Quality, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous problems into thoughtful, scalable, and trustworthy experiences. The patterns you establish will influence product teams across Vanta.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Designer, Agent Experience at Vanta:

  • Lead end-to-end design for projects across the agent harness, from problem framing and discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Define how agents, skills, tools, and memory are composed, surfaced, and understood by customers.

  • Design experiences that help customers delegate real security and compliance work while maintaining visibility, control, and confidence.

  • Create patterns for reviewing, correcting, approving, interrupting, and recovering from agent-generated work.

  • Design conversational and agent interaction models across Vanta, Slack, and other surfaces where our agents appear.

  • Establish product patterns and principles for trustworthy agent behavior, including transparency, permissions, uncertainty, explainability, and graceful failure.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate when an agent is the right solution for a customer problem.

  • Conduct customer discovery and usability testing with security, compliance, and GRC users.

  • Translate customer insights, product requirements, technical constraints, and AI quality considerations into clear design direction.

  • Collaborate with Design Systems and product designers across Vanta to turn emerging AI patterns into reusable, high-quality experiences.

  • Create design briefs, workflow models, prototypes, specifications, and other artifacts that bring clarity to complex problems.

  • Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership.

  • Contribute to design critique and help raise the quality bar for interaction design, information architecture, UX writing, and visual craft.

  • Help shape how Vanta approaches responsible AI and human control across the product.

  • Identify opportunities to improve how the design organization and product teams work together.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with depth in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or other sophisticated software products.

  • Experience designing AI-powered products, automation, or systems where product behavior may be dynamic or uncertain.

  • Ability to design agent experiences beyond chat, including systems involving agents, skills, tools, memory, and multi-step workflows.

  • Experience designing products that require human judgment, including deciding when and how to bring a person into an automated workflow.

  • Experience designing across surfaces that a product team may not fully control, such as Slack, terminal environments, or other third-party interfaces.

  • Strong product thinking and discovery skills, including the ability to frame ambiguous problems and identify the right questions to answer.

  • High craft in interaction design, information architecture, UX writing, and visual design.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and customer-facing teams.

  • A thoughtful approach to responsible AI, including transparency, data control, human review, explainability, and recovery from incorrect or incomplete outputs.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates shipped work, complex workflows, meaningful tradeoffs, and learning from customers or users.

  • Ability to move fluidly between systems-level thinking and detailed interaction design.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional partners without formal authority.

  • Curiosity, sound judgment, and comfort working in emerging product spaces where patterns and best practices are still taking shape.

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

title: Senior Product Manager, Commitments
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Product Manager at Vanta, you will be responsible for the Commitments product, which enables customers to track the security commitments they make in their contracts, powered by the Vanta Agent. Today, tracking contractual commitments is manual and decentralized. As a result, when a security event happens or buyers ask about adherence to said commitments, GRC and security teams are left to scramble to find the answer. Vanta’s Commitments product solves this problem by leveraging AI and the Vanta Agent to automatically categorize commitments in contracts, tie them directly to customer programs, and enable them to proactively understand what they’re committing to before the agreement is signed, and effectively track those commitments.

As the PM for Commitments, you will own the agentic product strategy for this area, enabling GRC teams to unlock new business opportunities, while meeting their obligations.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Strategic Finance
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Finance team, you’ll play a pivotal role in uncovering the insights that shape company-wide planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making. This high-impact role blends analytical rigor, technical fluency, and business acumen to steer strategy and identify opportunities for scalable growth.

The Finance Data team partners with both Finance and other teams across Vanta. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders to build trust and deliver data-driven recommendations; your work will influence everything from operating plans and investment decisions to self-serve reporting and process automation. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your analytics expertise in a dynamic, high-growth environment, with visibility into executive-level priorities and the ability to shape them with data.

What you’ll do as a Senior Data Analyst at Vanta:

  • Deliver strategic insights by conducting deep, prioritized analyses that inform high-impact financial decisions.

  • Act as a technical partner to teams across FP&A, Accounting, RevOps, Product, Marketing, and more.

  • Increase team efficiency by automating recurring deliverables and helping scale workflows as the company grows.

  • Empower decision-makers with self-service dashboards and data assets that surface trends and drive informed choices across the business.

  • Advance our analytics infrastructure by partnering with Data Engineering and other analytics teams to democratize access to high quality data and insights.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in data analysis or equivalent function. Exposure to FP&A, Accounting, or SaaS metrics is a plus.

  • Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Sigma), with experience handling large and complex data sets. Familiarity with DBT is preferred. Bonus points for skill in Python for advanced analysis.

  • Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to analyze complex data sets, uncover key insights, and translate findings into actionable strategies that drive financial outcomes.

Internal comms sits at the heart of that mission: making sure every Vanta'n understands our strategy, our story, and what's expected of them, no matter how fast we're moving.

Reporting to the Head of People, this is a build-from-scratch mandate. You'll define the strategy, the infrastructure, and the cadence for how Vanta communicates. You'll have room to bring your own voice and instincts into how we do it, from the words we choose for a key company moment to how an all-hands actually feels in the room. Then you'll roll up your sleeves to make it happen.

What you’ll do as an Internal Communications Director at Vanta:

  • Shape how Vanta tells its own story internally and ensure that key messages land at exactly the right moment.

  • Build and manage internal comms infrastructure: the channels, cadences and best practices for how the company communicates (Slack norms, docs, wikis, etc.).

  • Own key internal company-wide moments end to end, including all-hands, major announcements, and org-wide notifications, from planning through delivery.

  • Partner closely with the People team as a strategic sounding board on sensitive or high-stakes communications

  • Serve as a strategic communications partner across the business, triaging and prioritizing company-wide communication requests and partnering with stakeholders to translate complex topics into clear, effective messaging.

  • Partner with Marketing and External Comms to keep our internal and external narrative aligned and consistent.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the C-team and Leadership Team on how and when to communicate major business updates.

  • Build and protect company culture and morale through comms, keeping the energy and momentum visible as Vanta grows.

  • Evolve Vanta's internal comms strategy and toolkit as the company scales, experimenting with new formats and channels.

  • Measure and iterate on what's working, bringing a data-informed lens to internal comms.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8-10+ years of experience building and running an internal comms strategy, ideally at a high-growth company.

  • Proven track record on building an internal comms strategy and executing on that strategy

  • Strong writer and storyteller who can translate complex or sensitive topics into clear, human messaging.

  • Comfortable operating at both altitudes. Can set strategy but is equally willing to execute (write the email, run the all-hands, edit the deck).

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer for the Activation team in our Self-Serve group. For a startup, getting SOC2 and ISO compliant is often the first serious security milestone, and it can stall for months. Activation exists to change that: we want every startup that signs up for Vanta to reach audit-ready in days, not months with an AI.

The Activation team is responsible for helping customers get key value out of the product after they purchase. When customers get that value, they're more likely to retain and grow. Activation is an experimentation team, an execution team, and a collaborative platform team - influencing how the rest of the company does growth and designs for a consistent growth experience.

As the Staff Product Designer on Activation, you'll set the experience vision for how customers get compliant with Vanta and you'll carry it from strategy to shipped product. You'll own work that spans multiple quarters, shape the roadmap with your PM and engineering partners, and set direction in a space where the right answer isn't obvious yet. You'll proactively champion craft, best growth experience practices, and a data centric approach to design. You'll also document the strategy and lead the room: sometimes authoring briefs that define our bets, and running stakeholder forums that keep large initiatives moving.

You will report to a Design Manager on the Self-Serve design team, within Vanta's Experience Design organization.

  • Design agent-first experiences: decide what the Vanta Agent does on its own, where people review and approve, and how the product earns trust at each step.

  • Create new, reusable AI patterns and extend existing ones, so other teams can build guided, agentic experiences faster and more consistently.

  • Define the activation outcomes your work is accountable for, partner with Data to instrument them, and run the experiments and iterations that move them.

  • Lead customer discovery with cross functional partners and lean engineering teams and share what you learn with leadership in a clear, compelling narrative.

  • Align partner teams so growth experiences feel like one product, not an org chart.

  • Document the product strategy for your area: write briefs, and POV docs that frame the problem, the bet, and the plan, so partners can make decisions without you in the room.

  • Drive large, multi-team initiatives from kickoff to launch in partnership with your Activation squad: set up and run recurring reviews and working sessions with key stakeholders, track decisions and dependencies, and keep everyone aligned as plans change.

  • Raise the quality bar for interaction, visual, and content craft across Self-Serve through critique, mentorship, and close partnership with engineering through launch.

  • Proven ability to set direction in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces: you frame the problem, write the brief, make principled tradeoffs, and bring a clear position to the table.

  • Strong written strategy skills. You've authored product briefs, strategy docs, or roadmaps that leadership used to make real decisions.

  • Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives, including running the recurring meetings, reviews, and rituals that keep many stakeholders aligned and work moving.

  • Fluency with product analytics and experimentation. You define success metrics, design tests, and change course based on results, including the ones you didn't want.

  • Exceptional interaction, visual, and content craft on dense, complex product UI, plus experience building patterns that scale across teams.

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills. You can align a squad, partner teams, and executives around a direction, and keep momentum through setbacks.

  • Experience working through and alongside other designers to deliver larger efforts, and a habit of mentoring and giving candid, useful feedback.

  • A portfolio is required, showing end-to-end product work, the reasoning behind key decisions, and the outcomes it delivered.

  • Experience with product-led growth, onboarding, or guided-setup experiences, especially for small teams or founders.

  • Experience designing agentic workflows, conversational interfaces, or human-in-the-loop review flows.

Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.

Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.

This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

 

What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

  • Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

  • Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

  • Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

  • Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

  • Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

  • Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

  • Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

  • A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

  • A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own — alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

  • Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary design

As a Vanta Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a pivotal role in guiding customers through their security and compliance journeys with Vanta's specialized solutions. By combining your customer-centric approach with expertise in Vanta's products and security best practices, you will contribute to the overall success and satisfaction of Vanta's customers in achieving robust security and compliance outcomes through retention of customers and health of the book of business.

Vanta’s success over the last year was exponential and we are now working to solve the problem of how to provide world-class customer experience to as many security-minded software companies as possible. As a Vanta Senior Customer Success Manager, you will be the voice of Vanta, responsible for helping keep our customers moving toward their goals and ultimately successful and happy.

This is a hybrid role (three days a week in office) based out of our Sydney office.

What you’ll do as a Customer Success Manager at Vanta:

  • Guide our customers in our Upmarket segment through onboarding, implementation, product adoption, and value-driven success.

  • Work with Vanta customers across industries, functions, and stages of their customer journey in a strategic manner.

  • Proactively partner with Account Managers by flagging at-risk accounts, providing customer insights, and highlighting expansion opportunities

  • Empower customers to become self-sufficient Vanta champions, solving their immediate needs while focusing on their long-term success, value realization, and retention.

  • Monitor and prioritize your book of business based on key indicators of customer health via Catalyst, our CS platform.

  • Serve as the point of contact for your customers and drive them to specific business outcomes on their timelines.

  • Become a product expert on Vanta and how our platform can be used to improve security posture through our compliance offerings (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, USDP and Custom Frameworks), Trust Reports, and Risk Management solution.

  • Provide insightful technical answers and recommend the most efficient way for customers to achieve compliance using our platform while leveraging cross-functional resources and specialized teams.

  • Partner with your CS team to co-create plays to drive engagement across the Vanta customer base with impactful adoption and retention results.

  • Liaise with Support to help quarterback resolutions for customer issues

  • Serve as the voice of your customers cross-functionally, providing feedback to the Product team and broader business

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in Customer Success at a SaaS company.

  • Background in running a strategic book of business.

  • Willingness to collaborate with others and drive mutually beneficial outcomes

  • Self-motivated and curious: Bias for action and committed to iterating when necessary

  • Work effectively in a highly ambiguous, ever-changing environment

  • Possess clear and thoughtful communication skills, with strong critical thinking ability

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Experience with hitting retention targets and creating happy, healthy customers

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

  • Experience working in the security or compliance industry is a bonus

  • Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar

We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.

Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta:

  • Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

  • Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

  • Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

  • Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

  • Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

  • Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

  • Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

  • Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

  • Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

  • Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

  • Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

  • Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

  • Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

  • Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

  • Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

  • Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the London office.

This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on.

Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures.

  • Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement.

  • Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture.

  • Be detail-oriented and organised, with strong project management skills.

  • Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills.

  • Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus.

  • Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity, GRC (governance, risk, and compliance), or audit space.

The Activation & Onboarding team is building the agentic front door to Vanta: an onboarding experience where the Vanta agent sets up, configures, and starts running a customer's security program for them, instead of handing them a checklist. The team owns how new small customers get from signup to value across the full platform (GRC, Trust Center, TPRM, Risk, Access, Privacy), and owns the product experience for onboarding a company to Vanta.

This role is equal parts art and science. The art is owning the vision for an onboarding experience where the Vanta agent does the heavy lifting, and sales, onboarding, and success teams step in where they add the most value, all as one seamless experience. The science is owning conversion and activation end to end and sweating the details of every step, experiment, and conversion between signup and value. This is a company-level initiative and the engine of Vanta’s acquisition and activation. It sets time to value, conversion, and expansion for every new customer, and it’s where Vanta proves that an agent can run a security program.

What you’ll do as a Staff Product Manager, Activation at Vanta:

  • Own and drive the self-serve onboarding experience for startups and downmarket customers. You will be the single accountable owner for creating a coherent, high-converting journey from first interaction through meaningful product adoption.

  • Partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Account Management to build one scalable self-serve program across products and packaging.

  • Work across Vanta’s product teams to make it effortless for customers to discover, configure, and adopt Vanta’s products and platform capabilities as their needs evolve.

  • Establish the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for product activation and onboarding across the customer lifecycle

  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM teams to define success metrics, identify friction, run experiments, and improve activation and time-to-value

  • Own the whole outcome. You will own a massive surface area spanning multiple departments, organizations, products, and customer segments. You feel accountable for creating one singular, coherent experience that makes Vanta feel seamless from the outside.

  • Speak fluent GTM and Account Management. While we are building a self-serve motion, it must operate as one program across the customer segment. You understand how and when Sales, Customer Success, and Account Management should engage, and how to design the right handoffs between product-led and service-supported experiences.

You build strong relationships quickly and bring people together around a clear customer and business outcome.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As an Account Executive, SLED Government at Vanta, you will be responsible for driving a significant share of revenue by guiding new business and growth with State, Local, and Education organizations. Reporting directly to the Head of Public Sector, this is a highly visible role that requires cross-functional collaboration, strategic vision, and operational execution.

Vanta for Government is Vanta’s AI-powered platform that helps government agencies and vendors protect mission data, manage risk, streamline compliance, and build trust – faster and with less manual work.

Vanta’s public sector efforts are growing quickly and this is an exciting opportunity to join a new team dedicated explicitly to public sector sales. We are looking for a passionate, results-oriented, and collaborative sales executive who has a proven track-record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals within SLED markets.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive, SLED Government at Vanta:

  • In coordination with Vanta leadership, develop and execute a comprehensive strategy to build, maintain, and expand Vanta for Government business across the SLED market.

  • As an individual contributor, proactively work to cultivate, pursue, and capture SLED sales opportunities.

  • Work cross-functionally to drive the sales and implementation of complex contracts, services, and solutions, with the ability to close sales through effective sales and negotiation methods.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Vanta and key SLED accounts, and represent Vanta’s Public Sector team at industry events and conferences.

  • Establish and grow strategic relationships with SLED decision-makers, systems integrators, and technology partners to expand access and accelerate deals.

  • Partner closely with SLED-specific resellers, distributors, MSPs, and channel partners to expand access and accelerate deals.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the SLED market, helping inform Vanta’s product roadmap, pricing strategy, service delivery, and positioning to meet customer needs.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of progressive enterprise sales experience, including at least 4 years selling to SLED agencies within a SaaS company. Experience working in government is a plus.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset that biases to action and leads with resilience through a fast-moving, complex, and collaborative environment.

  • Strong understanding of SLED sales cycles, SLED procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements (e.g., GovRAMP), acquisition regulations, and partner ecosystems.

  • Strong verbal and written communications skills, with the ability to demonstrate Vanta’s vision and values to a variety of public sector audiences.

  • Develop a deep familiarity with Vanta’s software platform and how it can be used by government agencies to support real-world challenges. The ability to establish rapport with highly technical prospects is essential.

  • Strong collaboration with internal partners and external counterparts.

  • A deep passion for Vanta’s mission, public sector innovation, and mission-driven work.

  • A high level of empathy for customers, you are a consultative seller with a track record of long-term customer retention

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

title: Director, Vanta for Government Partnerships

Vanta's V4G Partnerships function sits at the intersection of our platform, the government agencies and contractors we serve, and the broad network of systems integrators, resellers, service providers, and auditors within the public sector compliance and risk management ecosystem. You'll help build and grow these partnerships to build pipeline, as well as to ensure that customers have access to high-quality, trusted delivery through Vanta.

As Director, Vanta for Government (V4G) Partnerships, you will own Vanta's partner function for the public sector — the strategy, the network, and the programs that let it scale — supporting both our government sales motion (Federal and SLED) and our government vendor business. Reporting directly to the Head of Public Sector, you will define the partner archetypes, tiering, and coverage model required to serve government demand, and own V4G partner-sourced pipeline and ARR that rolls into Vanta's overall partner-sourced target. You'll work in close partnership with the VP of Global Channel & Alliances, who owns that overall target and channel operating model, to ensure the public sector motion is built on — and strengthens — that foundation. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for someone who has built a public sector partner function from the ground up: designing joint GTM programs, negotiating enterprise partnership agreements, and standing up the mechanisms that let a partner network scale beyond the person running it.

You'll have meaningful scope: you'll own the V4G partner function — the strategy, the partner network, the program design, and the team — and decide how Vanta invests across public sector partners, including tiering, enablement investment, and where to expand or exit. You'll own the V4G partner-sourced pipeline and ARR contribution, and the coverage standard that determines how partner resources are leveraged and applied across Vanta’s government and commercial opportunities.You'll start with one partnerships manager and build the team as the segment grows, taking a “player-coach” approach to help establish that growth.

What you’ll do as a Director, Vanta for Government Partnerships at Vanta:

  • Own the V4G partner strategy across Federal and SLED — define the partner archetypes Vanta needs (resellers, service partners, GSIs, 3PAOs and C3PAOs), the tiering and coverage model, and the multi-year plan to build a network that meets government and commercial demand.

  • Own the V4G partner-sourced pipeline and ARR contribution to Vanta's partner-sourced target, and define the metrics by which public sector partner performance, partner health, and network coverage are measured — including the coverage standard for FedRAMP and CMMC delivery capacity.

  • Design the programs and mechanisms that let the network scale — partner tiering and certification, enablement paths, co-sell motion, MDF and investment allocation, partner health frameworks, and standardized partner agreements built with Legal.

  • Build and lead the V4G partnerships team, starting with one manager and scaling with the segment. Set the operating rhythms, quality bar, and performance standards, and develop the team to own partner relationships directly.

  • Partner with the VP of Global Channel & Alliances and the broader channel organization to extend the V4G motion across Vanta's full partner ecosystem — including MSPs, VARs, and auditors working on federal compliance programs like FedRAMP and CMMC — ensuring the public sector motion strengthens rather than duplicates the commercial one.

  • Serve as the voice of the government ecosystem inside Vanta, with a influence in V4G product roadmap, packaging, and pricing decisions — translating what partners, commercial customers, and government agencies need into a prioritized point of view Product and Engineering can act on.

  • Expand the network and reduce concentration risk by identifying and onboarding new firms, capturing demand from large partners not yet engaged, and making clear calls about where Vanta invests and where it walks away.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience managing public sector channel and/or partnerships, with a strong network across GSIs, managed service providers, resellers, and auditors.

  • Deep familiarity with the public sector ecosystem, including Federal and SLED go-to-market motions and federal compliance programs, such as FedRAMP and CMMC.

  • 5+ years of people management experience, including managing performance across a team.

  • Experience owning a revenue target delivered through partners, including defining the metrics and operating cadence required to hit it.

  • Proven ability to build, manage, and grow external partner relationships at scale — ideally within cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance-adjacent ecosystems.

  • Experience partnering with systems integrators, MSPs, VARs, and audit firms; direct audit or assessor experience is a plus but not required.

  • Strong instincts for balancing technical/domain credibility with business development thinking

  • Track record of building or scaling a partner or channel network, reducing risk through diversification, or driving quality programs in an external-facing capacity

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functionally across GTM, product, legal, marketing, and channel sales teams

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and building structure in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Vanta for Government team, you'll set the technical foundation for Vanta's expansion into the public sector: designing the systems, patterns, and architecture that will power compliance programs from the ground up for government vendors and agencies.

The Vanta for Government team is building and evolving Vanta's AI-powered platform for government vendors, federal agencies, and State, Local, and Education (SLED) organizations. Our mission is to make government compliance not easy, but easier: helping organizations automate the heavy lifting across complex frameworks like FedRAMP, CMMC, and NIST, strengthen their security posture, and support mission-critical work with greater confidence.

You’ll work directly alongside early design partners to shape new capabilities in real time. As the most senior engineer on the team, you'll be the technical anchor through a critical build phase — making the architectural decisions, establishing engineering patterns, and driving the multi-quarter initiatives that will define how Vanta serves government customers at scale.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

What you'll do as a Staff Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the technical strategy and architecture for Vanta's government product line, designing systems that adapt Vanta's core compliance platform to meet the demands of federal agencies, government vendors, and SLED organizations

  • Lead the design and build of net-new product capabilities — including core compliance workflow features that don't yet exist in Vanta's product today — working alongside early design partners to validate and iterate as requirements evolve

  • Define reusable abstractions and platform patterns that prevent technical debt as the team scales from its first government customers to a broader portfolio of agencies and vendors

  • Partner with adjacent engineering teams on shared infrastructure and tagging systems that underpin government-specific compliance workflows, building on existing platform investments rather than starting from scratch

  • Drive multi-quarter technical initiatives across engineering, product, and go-to-market, translating ambiguous early-stage requirements into durable, scalable solutions

  • Raise the technical bar for a team of mid-level and senior engineers through mentorship, code review, engineering practice-setting, and high-quality technical decision-making

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

  • Strong systems thinking and platform architecture skills: you design for reuse, scalability, and long-term maintainability, and naturally think in terms of abstractions and patterns

  • Experience in highly regulated industries such as fintech or healthcare; FedRAMP or government domain experience is a plus, but not required

  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, 0→1 environments where requirements evolve as you learn from customers and technical decisions carry real business consequences

  • A strong product mindset: you understand that shipping matters, can prioritize against real deadlines, and balance technical rigor with delivery velocity

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across engineering and bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proven ability to mentor and develop engineers, with a track record of raising team-wide technical quality and building strong engineering culture

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

title: Sales Development Representative, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

At Vanta, being an Enterprise SDR is first about hitting targets and driving revenue. It also means joining a community that’s committed to your success and career growth. We believe the future of our sales organization lies with our SDRs, so we invest heavily in enablement and career advancement. You’ll get the training, support and mentorship you need to excel, with a clear path to an Account Executive role.

 

As an Enterprise SDR, you’ll partner with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Marketing and channel partners to create pipeline at large organizations (2,000+ employees). You’ll engage senior security, risk and compliance leaders who are under growing pressure from audits, security reviews, third-party risk and AI governance.

 

You don’t need SaaS or cybersecurity experience to be great at this job. We’ll teach you the product, the tools and the process. What we can’t teach is drive, curiosity and coachability, and that’s what we’re hiring for. Great SDRs come from everywhere: commission- or tip-based roles, hospitality, retail, call centers, fundraising, recruiting, real estate, political campaigns, competitive athletics, or something they started on their own.

 

Vanta is growing quickly and is profitable. We keep beating our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS scores, so it’s an exciting time to join. If you’re hungry to learn and ready to work hard, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as a Sales Development Representative at Vanta:

  • Learn Vanta’s value proposition and Trust Management Platform, including compliance automation, continuous monitoring, Trust Center, questionnaire automation, vendor risk management and AI governance. Explain them clearly and confidently to enterprise buyers.

  • Own a named book of enterprise accounts. Build account plans and run multi-threaded outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn, using tools you’ll be trained on: Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Nooks, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Nav, 6Sense and Gong.

  • Prospect into senior leaders such as CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, VPs and Directors of Security, Heads of GRC, Compliance Managers, and IT Risk and Internal Audit leaders.

  • Research accounts to find why-now triggers, such as new frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 42001), new security leadership, M&A, funding, audit findings or vendor risk initiatives.

  • Qualify opportunities against Vanta’s criteria: pain, champion, compelling event and a scheduled next step. Book qualified meetings on your AE’s calendar and log your activity in Salesforce.

  • Handle objections, including incumbent GRC tools and “we built it in-house,” and keep conversations going after a first “no.”

  • Help drive attendance at Vanta events, executive dinners and partner programs. Give Marketing feedback on lead quality and messaging.

  • Join weekly pipeline meetings with your AE pod and report progress on target accounts.

  • Grow your skills through SDR training, regular call coaching and a defined path to Enterprise AE.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Be enthusiastic about cold calling. Cold calling is at the heart of this role. Being excited to pick up the phone and engage senior executives will set you apart.

  • Be relentless in your work ethic. Meeting or exceeding the daily minimum of activities takes discipline and self-motivation. You set big goals and push yourself to hit them.

  • Show grit. You’ve pushed through rejection or a setback and kept going, whether on a team, at work, in school or on a personal goal. Enterprise deals involve many stakeholders and long cycles, so persistence matters.

  • Be coachable. You ask for feedback, take it well and act on it quickly. We review calls and emails regularly, and the fastest learners grow the fastest.

  • Be curious and resourceful. You figure things out, ask good questions and pick up new topics quickly, including security and compliance concepts and the business problems they create.

  • Use AI thoughtfully. You use AI to strengthen your research and outreach, and you apply it responsibly to improve your efficiency and impact.

  • Communicate with confidence. You’re clear on the phone and in writing, you listen well, and you represent Vanta with empathy, especially with executive audiences.

  • Be strategic. You’ll manage a book of enterprise accounts, decide who to prioritize, tailor your approach to each persona and work closely with your AE on account strategy.

  • Work hybrid. You’ll need to be able to commute to the office 3 days per week.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What you can expect as a Vanta'n:

  • Industry-competitive compensation

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks fully-paid parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness and remote workplace stipends

  • Family planning benefits

  • 401(k) matching

  • Flexible work hours and location

  • Open PTO policy

  • 11 paid holidays in the US

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, and Sydney

title: Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager, Mid-Late Sales Funnel
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. The team owns the operational strategy and execution of our mid-to-late GTM Sales motion for the NAMER Upmarket organization, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. We build and evolve the sales processes, workflows, data, and policies that enable sellers to effectively manage opportunities, navigate complex deals, and convert pipeline into predictable revenue.

Our work spans opportunity management, forecasting, complex deal strategy and structuring, contracting workflows, and Rules of Engagement. We work hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate critical deals and day-to-day business challenges, while identifying where broader processes, policies, data, or systems need to evolve. We partner closely across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other GTM teams to improve seller effectiveness, sales efficiency, conversion, and revenue predictability as the business scales.

What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and day to day operations for the Upmarket mid-to-late sales funnel, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. Develop a strong point of view on the sales processes, stage management, opportunity management, workflows, and seller behaviors needed to improve conversion, sales efficiency, and predictable revenue growth.

  • Own and evolve the operational workflows and data that support contracting and complex deal execution, ensuring sellers have clear, scalable paths from opportunity through contract and close. Serve as a go-to strategic and operational partner for creative and complex deal structures, working hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate non-standard scenarios while partnering closely with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Use insights from individual deals to identify recurring friction and drive improvements to the processes, policies, data, and systems that enable the business to close effectively at scale.

  • Shape deal strategy and the operational processes that support complex sales motions, partnering with sellers, Sales leadership, Deal Desk, Finance, and other teams to navigate complex opportunities while identifying where broader process, policy, or system changes can make it easier and more effective to close business at scale.

  • Evolve the Rules of Engagement and the cross-functional policies that govern how GTM teams work together throughout the sales cycle, bringing clarity to ownership, handoffs, deal scenarios, and areas of competing priorities. Lead alignment across Sales and other GTM organizations as our sales motions and business needs evolve.

  • Own and evolve sales forecast cadences, facilitating forecast reviews with Sales leadership to scrutinize pipeline health and deal-specific risks.

  • Identify and lead strategic improvements to our mid-to-late funnel operating model, using data, field insights, and deep sales process expertise to diagnose where opportunities are getting stuck or where seller effectiveness can improve. Lead complex initiatives from problem definition and recommendation through senior stakeholder alignment, hands-on implementation, and measurement of business impact in partnership with GTM Systems & Analytics and other cross-functional teams.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 12+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, or a related function within B2B SaaS, with significant experience supporting complex Upmarket sales motions.

  • Mid to late funnel GTM experience and opportunity-to-close processes across Commercial, Mid-Market, and Enterprise. You understand opportunity management, sales stages and methodology, forecasting, pipeline health, complex buying cycles, and how decisions throughout the funnel impact revenue outcomes.

  • Strong experience with complex deal strategy and Deal Desk, including pricing and approvals, contracting workflows, non-standard deal structures, and complex commercial scenarios. You’re comfortable getting into the details of an individual opportunity and partnering with sellers to develop creative paths to close while balancing the broader needs of the business.

  • A hands-on operating style with the ability to move fluidly between setting direction and getting into the weeds across opportunities, data, account and opportunity hierarchies, systems, processes, and seller workflows. You’re naturally investigative, able to identify root causes and patterns, and turn what you learn into scalable improvements.

  • Strong business judgment and a clear point of view. You combine data, GTM expertise, and field context to make recommendations in ambiguous situations, evaluate tradeoffs and downstream implications, and advocate for a direction while remaining open to new information.

  • Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functionally, from frontline sellers to senior Sales and GTM leadership. You can build alignment across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other partners, navigate competing priorities, and challenge constructively without relying on direct authority.

  • Experience serving as a trusted partner to senior Sales leadership—understanding the needs of the business, bringing a point of view on what should change, and staying close enough to the work to help drive outcomes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Program Structure & Trust
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

 

Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.

 

Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.

 

This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.

 

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

  

What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

  • Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

  • Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

  • Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

  • Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

  • Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

  • Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around

 

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

  • Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

As the AI Agent Support Specialist, You'll own Ask-Ilma, Vanta's customer-facing AI agent, built on Fin by Intercom, and the first point of contact for customers seeking support.. You're accountable for whether customers get the right answer, how the experience feels, and how smoothly Fin hands off to our support engineers when it should. Our customers rely on Vanta to get compliance right, so a fast answer only counts if it's also a correct one.

This is a hands-on role for someone who treats an AI agent like a product: something to measure, tune, test, and improve every week.

What you’ll do as a AI Agent Support Specialist at Vanta:

Performance: Own how well Fin works

An AI agent's performance drifts without a clear owner, and that owner is you. You'll have a bias for action, shipping improvements quickly and learning from the results. You'll also decide with frameworks, so the team always understands why one fix came before another.

  • Review Fin conversations weekly to find wrong answers, self-service gaps, and avoidable escalations.

  • Make changes in Fin yourself (guidance, content, workflows). Treat most as two-way doors: ship, measure, adjust.

  • Keep a ranked list of improvements based on customer impact, volume, and risk.

  • Set and document Fin's guardrails: what it must never answer, when it asks a clarifying question, and when it escalates.

Knowledge: Own what Fin knows

Fin is only as accurate as what it knows. Our customers trust Vanta to get compliance right, and we do what it says on the tin, so Fin's knowledge has to be correct and current.

  • Own the knowledge Fin draws from: snippets, internal content, and our help center.

  • Set the governance: every topic has an owner and a review cadence, and outdated or conflicting content gets retired.

  • When a support engineer answers something Fin couldn't, turn it into reusable knowledge so we only answer it once.

  • Set AI-ready content standards, and partner with Customer Education to bring help-center articles up to them.

Customer Experience: Own how Fin feels to customers

For many customers, Fin is the first Vanta "teammate" they talk to. Because we put our customers first, how Fin makes them feel matters as much as what it says.

  • Shape how Fin sounds, including how it says "I don't know" without leaving customers stuck.

  • Own handoffs: when Fin escalates, where it routes, and what context it passes so customers never repeat themselves.

  • Dig into low CSAT ratings and dead ends, and fix the root cause.

  • Handle a small volume of tickets to stay close to real customer problems.

Launch Readiness: Own Fin's readiness for every launch

Vanta ships fast, and customers ask about new features the day they launch. We win as one team and lead with resilience, so Fin is ready on day one, even when plans change late.

  • Partner early with Product, Engineering, and Customer Education to get source-of-truth content before features ship.

  • Have Fin tested and ready on launch day, then watch closely and close gaps fast.

  • Evaluate new Fin capabilities and recommend which to adopt.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Support expertise: 3+ years in technical support at a B2B SaaS company, including troubleshooting complex customer issues. TSS / Sr. TSS experience is preferred.

  • AI support tool experience: hands-on experience with AI-powered support tools, as a user or an admin, and a clear view of where they work well and where they don't.

  • Structured writing: you can turn a messy process into clear, well-organized knowledge that both people and AI can use.

  • Data-driven decisions: you're comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data, spotting trends, and using them to decide what to fix first.

  • Systems thinking: when you see a bad answer, you ask what in the system caused it, then fix that so it doesn't happen again.

  • Customer judgment: you can tell when an answer is technically right but still a bad experience, and when a customer needs a person.

  • Nice to have: Experience administering Intercom and Fin, including guidance, snippets, Procedures, or AI Insights.

  • Nice to have: Background in knowledge management, content design, or writing for conversational interfaces.

  • Nice to have: Experience leading a support tool rollout or migration.

  • Nice to have: Exposure to security, compliance, or GRC concepts.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

Our Senior Software Engineers lead and mentor engineers, delivering high-value products for our customers and infrastructure that enables our business to scale.

Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for setting technical direction to enable our product and infrastructure to scale with our business, driving complex projects across our technical stack, and mentoring our talented engineering team. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta’s growth.

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

The GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) organization is the primary org responsible for developing and maintaining Vanta's core product offerings. These teams are at the heart of Vanta moving upmarket to support enterprise customers and build products that enable our customers’ existing security and compliance programs to integrate seamlessly with Vanta, giving them invaluable insights and recommendations to continue to operate, mature and evolve their programs.

  • Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders and engineers to deliver significant impact to our business

  • Set direction for critical technical surface areas, enabling us to stay ahead of continued rapid growth

  • Design, develop, and own new product functionality and/or infrastructure leveraging modern frameworks and tooling (TypeScript, React, Node.js)

  • Work with talented and kind engineers to make a significant impact on our customer base, enabling them to improve their security and prove it

  • Contribute to building Vanta’s engineering culture as we grow

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have at least 8 years of industry experience

  • Have played technical leadership roles for teams or complex projects

  • Have previous startup experience, or worked in an environment that prioritizes a bias for action

  • Have previous experience working on greenfield projects

  • Have an interest in learning about security or prior experience in the space

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
